item.content:encoded:
"Oh, boy, you're pretty high ranked if you know all of that." No response. "Still not everything…"

I know that you didn't intend it this way, TGs, but I am headcanoning that as including a reference to Figure and Ground (and in particular the ending I imagine to that story).

But as someone else who has used the Navarro character before, I agree with Jacob that the real deal is obvious even on short acquaintaince. Highly entertaining - accept no substitutes.

item.content:encoded:
Yes, I'd like to order the Navarro. With extra salt, if you could.

See, while I enjoy using the Navarro character, my interpretation is nowhere near as fun as the original, genuine product.

+1. This tale was the bee's knees.
